name: Qué Vaina — Open Mic
description: Qué Vaina Comedy Club presents a special Open Mic night featuring Latin American comedians, international artists, and surprise guests. The event includes performances by Oso, Paulo, Roberto, Feña, and Nicolás Guzmán.
longDescription:
Qué Vaina Comedy Club hosts a special Open Mic night at Nope Bar. The event features Latin American comedians, international artists, and surprise guests, promising material likely not heard before. Performers include Oso, Paulo, Roberto, Feña, and Nicolás Guzmán, with other talents joining the lineup.

The event takes place on November 3, 2026, starting at 8:30 PM. Tickets cost 5€ and include an international shot from the house to welcome guests to the new venue. The event is for ages 17 and up.

longDescriptionPt:
O Qué Vaina Comedy Club organiza uma noite especial de Open Mic no Nope Bar. O evento conta com comediantes da América Latina, artistas internacionais e convidados surpresa, prometendo material que provavelmente nunca ouviu antes. Os artistas incluem Oso, Paulo, Roberto, Feña e Nicolás Guzmán, com outros talentos a juntarem-se ao alinhamento.

O evento acontece a 3 de novembro de 2026, com início às 20h30. Os bilhetes custam 5€ e incluem um shot internacional da casa para dar as boas-vindas aos convidados ao novo espaço. O evento é para maiores de 17 anos.
